# SaaS-UI — full context for AI systems

SaaS-UI is an MIT-licensed, local-first visual editor for design systems. It is built with
React 18, Vite 5, and TypeScript. The editor runs entirely in the browser: projects are stored
in IndexedDB, preferences in localStorage, and no account or network connection is required.

## Product model

- Ten modules: Overview, Colors, Typography, Layout, Components, Effects, Motion, Assets,
  AI Rules, Export.
- The local editor is the product; the cloud is an optional upgrade.
- The open-source build has no API, authentication, or backend dependency.
- The hosted edition adds accounts, PostgreSQL row-level security, organizations, cloud sync,
  collaboration, billing, and administration.

## Persistence

- `localStorage` hydrates Zustand state for fast startup.
- IndexedDB (Dexie) stores the durable local project records.
- Autosave writes after a debounce; the footer shows saving, saved locally, unsaved, or error.

## Design principles

- Zinc-neutral surfaces with one indigo action color.
- Manrope for display, Inter for UI, JetBrains Mono for values.
- Borders before shadows; Lucide icons only; no emoji UI icons.
- 100–200 ms motion with `prefers-reduced-motion` respected.
- No fake metrics, testimonials, decorative buttons, or invented claims.

- Hosted edition: https://saasui.cloud
